major_concerns: External validity: Batfish sandbox may not capture production device semantics or vendor quirks.
Repair-overfitting: repair loop may satisfy verifier while introducing undetected regressions.
Prompt/model sensitivity and retry policy not fully specified; could bias paired comparisons.
Definition of ‘validator-detected error’ and harm oracle needs precise specification.
Public release and artifact reproducibility must be ensured for replication.
required_design_repairs: Precisely define validator properties, harm oracle, and non-verifier regression checks (e.g., performance/policy tests).
Specify exact model identifiers, prompt templates, seeds, and retry policy in preregistration; fix maximum model-call budget per task.
Add secondary checks to detect verifier-overfitting (e.g., randomized test packets, orthogonal validators).
Commit to public dataset/topology release and provide experiment code, Batfish configs, and hashes.
Clarify vendor stratification criteria and ensure balanced sample across vendors/complexities.

major_concerns: Dual-use risk from publishing adversarial prompt templates and red-team methods.
Operationalization of ‘harmful configuration’ must be precisely bounded to sandbox metrics.
Guard implementations may be ad-hoc; integration bugs could confound results.
Automated adversary generator may not reflect realistic social-engineering vectors.
Ethical oversight and safe-release policies are not described in detail.
required_design_repairs: Embed an explicit red-team ethics and safety plan in the preregistration; prohibit release of actionable adversarial templates without mitigation guidance.
Define and document sandbox-only harm oracle with precise checks; log and isolate all artifacts.
Provide detailed guard implementation specs and unit tests to rule out integration bugs.
Pre-register adversary generation algorithm and include human-red-team validation for realism (without releasing templates).
Add a baseline human-in-the-loop or human-review comparison if feasible, or justify its omission.

major_concerns: Automated operator proxy may poorly approximate real human decision-making and bias precision estimates.
Proxy training/validation data and held-out labels need specification and public release.
Risk that traces can be gamed, producing false confidence in proxy decisions.
Definition of ‘true safety labels’ from sandbox oracle must be explicit.
Calibration and confidence measures for the proxy are underspecified.
required_design_repairs: Provide full specification, data, and code for the automated operator proxy; include held-out validation metrics and calibration analysis.
If possible, include a small human-operator validation subset to demonstrate proxy fidelity or justify proxy-only design.
Explicitly define the sandbox oracle used for true safety labels and release test topologies/configs.
Include adversarial-trace tests to assess whether traces can be gamed and quantify their effect on proxy misclassification.
Pre-register proxy decision thresholds, confidence metrics, and evaluation rubric.

major_concerns: Implementation and integration effort differences between frameworks may confound results.
Traceability rubric appears partly subjective; needs objective, automatable metrics.
Ensuring comparable feature parity (tooling, verifier hooks) across frameworks is nontrivial.
Potential bias from unequal engineering polish or libraries used for each framework.
Cost and model-call accounting methods need precise definition.
required_design_repairs: Standardize integration requirements and enforce parity (same tools/verifiers) across frameworks; document integration effort.
Replace or augment subjective rubric with objective metrics (tool-call completeness, provenance entropy, automated detect/recover rates).
Pre-register concrete recovery policies, detection thresholds, and cost accounting methods (model calls, latency).
Open-source all orchestration implementations, test harness, and scripts; provide reproducibility checklist and hashes.
Include sensitivity analysis to integration effort and perform blinded assessment of trace quality where human judgment is used.
